API docs by Redocly

WSO2 APIM Catalog Backend Module Dependencies (1.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

Outbound WSO2 APIs consumed by the catalog-backend-module-wso2-apim plugin while discovering APIs, API products, MCP servers, services, global settings, and self-hosted gateway APIs. Direct OpenAPI YAML: catalog-backend-module-wso2-apim.yaml Postman collection: catalog-backend-module-wso2-apim.postman_collection.json

OAuth

Exchange client credentials for a WSO2 access token

Exchanges client credentials for a WSO2 access token.

Important: The client credentials must belong to an application owned/subscribed by a user with appropriate roles/permissions (such as admin or a publisher role) to authorize the requested scopes.

The scopes are categorized by task:

  • Core API Ingestion: apim:api_view apim:publisher_settings
  • Advanced Ingestion & Publishing: apim:api_create apim:api_publish apim:api_import_export
  • MCP Server Ingestion: apim:mcp_server_view apim:mcp_server_create apim:mcp_server_publish apim:mcp_server_generate_key apim:mcp_server_import_export apim:mcp_server_list_view apim:llm_provider_read
Authorizations:
BasicAuth
Request Body schema: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
required
grant_type
required
string
Value: "client_credentials"
scope
string

Space-separated list of scopes to request. Ensure the client credentials possess roles/permissions that allow requesting these scopes.

Responses

Local WSO2 API Manager base URL from WSO2_BASE_URL in 4.7.0.env.

https://localhost:9447/oauth2/token

Request samples

  • Get access token (All Scopes) 
curl -k -X POST 'https://localhost:9447/oauth2/token' \
  -u "$WSO2_CLIENT_ID:$WSO2_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  --data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials' \
  --data-urlencode 'scope=apim:api_view apim:publisher_settings apim:api_create apim:api_publish apim:api_import_export apim:mcp_server_view apim:mcp_server_create apim:mcp_server_publish apim:mcp_server_generate_key apim:mcp_server_import_export apim:mcp_server_list_view apim:llm_provider_read'

Publisher

Authorizations:
BearerAuth

Responses

Local WSO2 API Manager base URL from WSO2_BASE_URL in 4.7.0.env.

curl -k 'https://localhost:9447/api/am/publisher/v4/settings' \

List APIs from WSO2 Publisher

The catalog backend reads this endpoint in pages using limit=1000 and an increasing offset value until all Publisher APIs have been collected. API details, documents, and Swagger/AsyncAPI definitions are then enriched with bounded concurrency before the provider applies one full catalog mutation.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
query Parameters
limit
integer
Default: 1000

Maximum number of API summaries to return per page. The catalog backend uses 1000.

offset
integer
Default: 0

Zero-based offset of the first API summary to return. The catalog backend increments this by the number of APIs returned on each page.

Responses

Local WSO2 API Manager base URL from WSO2_BASE_URL in 4.7.0.env.

https://localhost:9447/api/am/publisher/v4/apis

Request samples

  • List APIs 
curl -k 'https://localhost:9447/api/am/publisher/v4/apis?limit=1000&offset=0' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WSO2_ACCESS_TOKEN"

Get API WSDL definition

Gets the WSDL definition for SOAP and SOAP-to-REST APIs.

The catalog WSO2 provider calls this endpoint while syncing SOAP APIs and stores the text WSDL response on the wso2.com/api-wsdl entity annotation when available. If WSO2 returns a ZIP archive instead of text WSDL, the provider skips storing it in the catalog annotation.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
apiId
required
string

Responses

Local WSO2 API Manager base URL from WSO2_BASE_URL in 4.7.0.env.

https://localhost:9447/api/am/publisher/v4/apis/{apiId}/wsdl

Request samples

  • Get WSDL definition 
curl -k 'https://localhost:9447/api/am/publisher/v4/apis/{apiId}/wsdl' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WSO2_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/wsdl+xml, text/xml, application/xml, application/zip, */*" \
  -o '{apiId}-wsdl'

Response samples

  • 200
  • 404
  • 500
